title: Origin of cold bias over the Arabian Sea in Climate Models
problem: Climate models exhibit a cold sea surface temperature bias over the Arabian Sea, but the origin of the anomalous cold winds causing this bias and their connection to the large-scale circulation is obscure, hindering accurate simulations of the Indian Summer Monsoon.
method: This paper proposes a mechanism whereby an equatorward bias in the subtropical jetstream originates the cold Sea Surface Temperature bias over the Arabian Sea in climate models by inducing subsidence and advection of cold, low-entropy air from the adjoining landmass, which cools the sea.
task: The task is to identify the origin of the cold Sea Surface Temperature bias over the northern Arabian Sea in CMIP5 climate models, linking it to an equatorward bias in the subtropical jet stream which causes anomalous cooling during the boreal spring.
